quest.title: Lost Key
quest.description: Wyatt, who escorts goods, is fond of drinking. However, after some heavy drinking, he has lost his key. Try following his footprints to find his key and bring it back to him.

dialogues.speaker: Wyatt
dialogues.text: Traveler! You couldn't have picked a better time.

dialogues.speaker: Wyatt
dialogues.text: Last night, I was on my way to the city to deliver these goods, when suddenly, some shining orbs caught my eye.

dialogues.speaker: Wyatt
dialogues.text: I—I'd had too much to drink, and... I just felt drawn to them, you know? I went to check it out and it turned out to be a huge group of slimes. They even bumped into me really hard!

dialogues.speaker: Wyatt
dialogues.text: I panicked and ran, but lost my way. It took me forever to find my cart again. Then, this morning, I found out my <color=#00E1FFFF>key</color> was gone...

dialogues.speaker: Wyatt
dialogues.text: Could you help me look for it? It's got to be around here somewhere... I feel like it's right under my nose.

response.speaker: Wyatt
response.text: Great! It's such a huge area, I just wouldn't know where to start looking.

choices.text: I have some pressing business to attend to.

response.speaker: Wyatt
response.text: This is such a huge area. I just don't know where to start looking. Please, you're the only one that can help me!

talks.objective: Use Elemental Sight to find the key

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I found this key — is it yours?

dialogues.speaker: Wyatt
dialogues.text: Yes! That's the one. I can't afford to let that happen again... I really must rein in my drinking.

dialogues.speaker: Wyatt
dialogues.text: Oh — and take these. Thanks for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Wyatt
dialogues.text: Well, it is quite a big search area... Good luck!
